name: Views XML Backend
description: Adds a Views query backend that reads a local or remote XML document as the data source, queried with XPath.
provides_plugin_types: Views query (ViewsQuery id: views_xml_backend; QueryPluginBase — the XML backend)

Views argument (views_xml_backend_standard, views_xml_backend_numeric, views_xml_backend_date, views_xml_backend_date_year, views_xml_backend_date_month, views_xml_backend_date_day, views_xml_backend_passthrough)
project_description: Views XML Backend is a Views plugin that adds native XPath 1.0 query generation. It allows you to parse XML/(X)HTML with XPath selectors using Views' graphical query builder. It registers an XML query backend as a Views base table; a display's query settings take an XML file URL or local path plus a row XPath, and field/filter/sort/argument handlers each carry their own XPath selector. Remote files are fetched over Guzzle with ETag/Last-Modified conditional caching to a hashed cache directory (default public://views_xml_backend), pruned weekly by cron. Sorting, paging and offset are applied in PHP after parsing.
